g.text: Observability: watch the services AND the pipelines
Left: is the app healthy (SRE)? Right: is delivery healthy (DORA)? Everything below is real config in this repo; numbers in mocks are examples.
SLO: 99% of requests succeed (30 days) -> error budget = 1%
# SLO: 99% of requests succeed (non-5xx) over 30 days -> error budget = 1%.
# Multi-window burn rate: page when we burn budget 14.4x too fast (2% of the 30-day budget
# in 1 hour), confirmed by the last 5 minutes so the alert clears quickly after a fix.
summary: "{{ $labels.job }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} is burning its error budget fast"
**Meaning.** More than 14.4% of requests to a service have failed (5xx) over the last hour *and*
the last 5 minutes. At this rate the 30-day error budget (1% of requests, SLO 99%) would be used up
in about 2 days. Users are affected right now.
1. Grafana → *Services (RED)* → error ratio: which service and which environment?
2. Grafana → *GitOps Delivery* → *What version runs where*: did the version change just before the errors started?
What version runs where max by (namespace, job, version) (app_build_info)
1 every run writes a summary (Actions -> run page)
- description: New revision synced and healthy
#gitops-demo ArgoCD: rocket orders-api-prod deployed and healthy.
deployments are Git commits, so git log gitops-config/environments/<env> is the deploy log
rollback commits count as failed changes
Grafana: syncs per app = deploy frequency
